text.tspan: ESWCap C+R Meter — carrier board Rev C.1
Sheet 3 — DUT bias, safety SSRs and DC-bias monitor (C-mode)
Team Praise Claude · Embedded Systems Workshop · 2026-11-14 · Sheet 3/7
J6 V_BIAS 0–20 V, 2-pin 5.08 mm terminal: pin 1 = V_BIAS, pin 2 = GND
DC feed, stiff at DC / open at AC
DC-bias monitor (C-mode: U10 on, U9 off)
Pre-charge: PB11 HIGH turns on SSR1 and SSR3 together (shared pin = hardware interlock).
Discharge: PB13 HIGH turns on SSR2 (100 Ω to GND). Firmware never runs SSR2 during a measurement.
Bias monitor: V_BIAS at the DUT = 11 × V(SH_DIV), up to ≈ 36 V. VN_SENSE also has D2 + C7 (sheet 4).
R33 10 MΩ across C1 slowly bleeds the blocking capacitor (sheet 2).
blue text = net name (identical to the KiCad schematic)
green dashed box = inside the STM32; ◦ PAx (J2-n) = MCU pin (WeAct header pin)
small numbers next to a part = its pin numbers
